title: Monitoring and Evaluation Officer
description:
Position: Monitoring and Evaluation Officer
Location: Remote with Hybrid Option (Ottawa)
Salary Range: $70,000 - $80,000
Summary
CODE is seeking a collaborative and learning-focused Monitoring and Evaluation (M&E) Officer to join our Programs Team. Reporting to the Director of Programs and Partnerships, the M&E Officer will play a key role in measuring, assessing, learning from, and reporting on program performance and results. This position is ideal for someone who combines strong analytical skills with a passion for continuous learning and program excellence.
What we offer

• Remote-first work environment with the flexibility to work from wherever you’re most productive

• Flexible and supportive work culture that values work-life balance

• Competitive salary

• Comprehensive extended health benefits

• 5% employer-matched registered pension plan

• 16 wellness days per year to support your health, wellbeing and personal needs

• $200 annual wellness reimbursement
About the role
Under the direction of CODE’s Director of International Programs and Partnerships, the M&E Officer will oversee CODE’s monitoring, evaluation, and learning systems to ensure program quality, accountability, and impact. Working closely with the Programs Team, they will contribute to program design, data analysis, and the development of results-based tools and dashboards. The Officer will also champion knowledge sharing and sector innovation by helping translate program learning into actionable insights that strengthen CODE’s work and reputation globally.

•

Evaluative Learning Project Support (50%)

• Lead the process of formal project evaluation including development of ToRs contracting and supervising external evaluators when required.

• Design, test, adapt and ensure the understanding and adoption of high-quality program results assessment tools for both project evaluation and monitoring with a focus on tools that have the potential to be used across all CODE.

• Linking educational expertise and learning and educational research methods and results to the CODE’s project evaluative learning systems and processes.

• Responsible for the management of CODE’s organizational program monitoring and results tracking systems, process and tools, including an M&E platform that is aligned with the organizational ToC and linked to projects.

• Support PMs, to link monitoring and data collection tools to comprehensive project and partner reporting tools. Link these reports to the organizational M&E framework above.

• Develop dashboards and program results reporting visualizations for the various clients of this information including internal and external stakeholders.

• Build the capacity of the programs team and local implementing partners to monitor, measure and evaluate program progress and results.

•

Organizational Learning and Knowledge Management (20%)

• Ensure that evaluative learning and outcome mapping processes are tracking and documenting innovation and education sector learning.

• Support staff from the Program Team as well as consultants and short-term staff to develop knowledge pieces, publications and presentations emerging from the Evaluative Learning process.

• Support efforts for CODE and/or its programs to be represented in important sector fora and events.

• Foster linkages to academic institutions that have research and learning goals that align with the program needs of CODE and its partners.

• Contribute to the development of country and organizational strategies with a focus on our organizational Logic Model, Logframe and Theory of Change.

•

Program and Partnerships Team Collaboration and Initiatives (20%)

• Support the Programs team in achieving their goals through regular team meetings, individual guidance and support and linking the team work to the CODE Performance Goals and Appraisal process.

• In collaboration with the Programs Team; development and supervision of consulting or short-term contracts from the roster

title: Cloud Network Engineer III
description:
Availity delivers revenue cycle and related business solutions for health care professionals who want to build healthy, thriving organizations. Availity has the powerful tools, actionable insights and expansive network reach that medical businesses need to get an edge in an industry constantly redefined by change.
At Availity , we're not just another Healthcare Technology company; we're pioneers reshaping the future of healthcare! With our headquarters in vibrant Jacksonville, FL, and an exciting office in Bangalore, India, along with an exceptional remote workforce across the United States, we're a global team united by a powerful mission.

We're on a mission to bring the focus back to what truly matters - patient care. As the leading healthcare engagement platform, we're the heartbeat of an industry that impacts millions. With over 2 million providers connected to health plans, and processing over 13 billion transactions annually, our influence is continually expanding.

Join our energetic, dynamic, and forward-thinking team where your ideas are celebrated, innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts. We're transforming the healthcare landscape, solving communication challenges, and creating connections that empower the nation's premier healthcare ecosystem. As an Availity Cloud Network Engineer III, you are responsible for the documentation, development, and maintenance of cloud implementations, with a focus on the network infrastructure. This individual is responsible for the hands-on coding and implementation of the designs provided by Cloud Architects and Security Teams. This individual will aid the Cloud Operations team in supporting Availity in AWS and is responsible for the development and operational work to support a multi-cloud environment.
Sponsorship, in any form, is not available for this position.
Location: Remote, US
Role qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree or the equivalent in relevant work experience

• 5 - 7 years of progressive work experience with cloud implementations and infrastructure as code

• 4+ years hands on AWS experience is a must

• 3+ years’ experience with Palo Alto firewalls

• Experience with F5 LTM

• CCSP, AWS Cloud, F5, Palo Alto certifications a plus

• Experience with IPSec VPN

• Dynamic Routing, Load Balancing, Network Access Control, Wireless, Zone Based Firewall

• Experience working with Product and Business Management teams a plus

• Experience working in an entrepreneurial company a plus

• Knowledge, skills, and experience to write detailed technical documentation

• Skilled in IAC, Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible

• Experience with CICD tooling such as Gitlab, Jenkins, etc.

• Scripting such as BASH and Python

• Knowledge of development methodologies (primarily Agile/Scrum)

• Experience with AWS and common AWS services

• Experience with monitoring and logging solutions

• Must be comfortable with Git.

• Excellent communication is essential to perform at maximum efficiency within the team.

• Collaborative attitude. This role is part of a larger and dynamic team that nurtures collaboration.

• Strong technical, process, and problem-solving proficiency.

What you will be doing:

• Engineering and support of multi-cloud and on-premises infrastructure

• Observability and reporting of network related infrastructure

• Working in AWS CLI and GitLab to orchestrate builds

• Monitoring JIRA throughout the sprint cycle

• Participate in daily stand ups and status check in meetings

• Builds and maintain infrastructure as code.

• Read and understand system and functional requirements

• Writes technical specifications and thorough documentation of work

• Reports on gaps in requirements for Technical Leads and Cloud Architects

• Accurately scopes project time and resources required to complete projects

• Reviews project scope and timeline estimates with senior staff

• Collaboration with Cloud Architects and business partners to confirm time and resource estimate

title: Director, Demand Generation
description:
At Meal Ticket , we empower the people and organizations who feed our communities. We are seeking a hands-on Director, Demand Generation to lead and execute our go-to-market engine, driving scalable pipeline growth through a high-leverage mix of strategy, campaign execution, and cutting-edge technology. Sitting at the center of our revenue motion, this player-coach role combines strategic full-funnel ownership with direct execution-giving you total visibility across paid media, SEO, lifecycle marketing, and ABM while working directly alongside our CRO.
We intentionally designed this role around an 80/20 split: 80% strategic demand generation tied directly to a pipeline target, and 20% cross-functional generalist work (product marketing support, sales enablement, and launch execution). You’ll own our end-to-end go-to-market motion alongside a lean, high-leverage resourcing model: one Content Strategist, a third-party paid/SEO agency, and a 13-agent AI marketing stack orchestrated by a Head-of-Marketing AI agent.
Key Objectives & Impact

• Pipeline Ownership: Direct accountability for marketing-sourced pipeline, MQL-to-SQL conversions, and CAC efficiency.

• Full-Funnel Demand Gen: Lead paid media, SEO, lifecycle marketing, webinars, events, and ABM campaigns targeted at our operator ICP.

• Orchestration & Execution: Act as a true player-coach-setting strategy for your agency, direct report, and AI stack while personally shipping high-priority campaigns.

• Sales Alignment: Partner directly with the CRO on monthly funnel reporting and pipeline forecasting.

Is This Role Right for You?

• You thrive on direct execution: You prefer shipping your own work and leveraging cutting-edge AI to accomplish your goals

• You’re tied to revenue: You have a proven track record of owning and hitting a hard pipeline number.

• You’re an AI-forward marketer: You are fully comfortable directing and optimizing automated AI agent workflows to multiply output.

What Success Demands in Year One

• Hitting the Pipeline Target: Consistently deliver against marketing-sourced pipeline goals committed directly to the CRO.

• Building a Predictable Engine: Establish a scalable, repeatable channel mix with fully validated CAC efficiency across all programs.

• Maximizing AI Operations: Orchestrate and continuously refine the 13-agent AI stack to drive significantly higher marketing output than traditional team structures can deliver at this budget.

What you will bring

• Bachelor’s degree

• 10+ years in B2B SaaS demand generation, including at least 2 years owning a pipeline number.

• A record of building multi-channel programs (paid, SEO, lifecycle, events) with tangible results.

• Fluency with modern martech and AI tooling.

• Comfort being measured on pipeline outcomes.

• Ability to work effectively in matrixed global organization

• Experience partnering with the CRO and CFO on pipeline and forecasting

Preferred
Credibility in vertical SaaS or hospitality technology, or a demonstrated ability to ramp into a new vertical quickly.
Please note: you must reside in one of the following states to qualify for this role - AZ, CT, FL, GA, ID, IN, KS, MI, MO, NC, NH, OH, PA, SC, TN, TX, VA

title: Business Development Manager
description:
We started a movement in which everyone can win - shoppers, retailers, society and every person on our team. To play fair, trust people and reward them for doing the right thing. We see and feel the impact of our work as more and more people gain financial freedom and retailers grow across the globe.

Founded in 2014 in Sydney, Australia, Afterpay has over 24 million active customers globally and more than 250,000 of the best retailers around the world including Anthropologie, Revolve, DSW, GOAT, Finish Line, Levi’s, Mac Cosmetics, Ray-Ban and many others.

Afterpay is helping people spend responsibly! We empower customers to access the things they want and need, while still allowing them to maintain financial wellness and control, by splitting payments in four, for both online and in-store purchases. Afterpay is deeply committed to delivering positive outcomes for customers. Now under the Block ecosystem, we are focused on supporting our community of shoppers.

We trust in the next generation and share a vision of a more accessible and sustainable world in which people are rewarded for doing the right thing. Join a movement in which everyone can win. 

The Role

As BDR Manager, you'll lead a team of five outbound BDRs focused on generating pipeline across SMB and Mid-Market merchants. You'll report directly to the UK CEO and play a key role in shaping how we prospect, hire, coach and grow the team.

This isn't a role where you're expected to maintain an existing playbook. We're looking for someone who enjoys building things; someone who sees opportunities to improve how a team operates and has the initiative to make them happen.

You'll have ownership over hiring, onboarding, coaching, outbound strategy and day-to-day team performance, while working closely with Sales Leadership, Marketing, CRM, Sales Strategy and other global teams.

 

You Will

 

• Lead, coach and develop a team of outbound BDRs.

• Build a high-performance culture in a hybrid working environment.

• Partner with AEs to maximise pipeline generation across SMB and Mid-Market.

• Hire and onboard new BDRs as the team grows.

• Continuously improve outbound strategy, messaging and account targeting.

• Partner with Marketing, CRM and Sales Strategy to improve how the team operates.

• Experiment with new tools, AI capabilities and ways of working.

• Use data to identify opportunities and improve team performance.

You Have

• Experience managing an outbound sales or business development team.

• A track record of hiring, coaching and developing high-performing sales talent.

• Confidence in managing performance.

• Experience improving outbound strategy rather than simply executing an existing playbook.

• Strong cross-functional stakeholder management skills.

• A data-driven approach to coaching and decision-making.

• Curiosity around AI and modern sales technology.

 
Application Guidelines

Candidates may submit up to 9 active applications within a 60-day period. Reapplications to the same role are accepted 90 days after a previous application has been reviewed.

Use of AI in Our Hiring Process

We may use automated AI tools to evaluate job applications for efficiency and consistency. These tools comply with local regulations, including bias audits, and we handle all personal data in accordance with state and local privacy laws. 

Contact us here  with hiring practice or data usage questions.

Every benefit we offer is designed with one goal: empowering you to do the best work of your career while building the life you want. Remote work, medical insurance, flexible time off, retirement savings plans, and modern family planning are just some of our offering.  Check out our other benefits at Block.

title: Senior Marketing Specialist Large Capital

Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first - developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.
A Day in the Life
The Regional Product Manager for United Kingdom, Ireland, Belgium and The Netherlands (UKIB) is a pivotal role focused on executing our Cranial & Spinal Technologies (CST) business strategy, with an emphasis on expanding our Spine portfolio and boosting growth in capital and robotics sales. You'll be essential in aligning and implementing marketing strategies locally while collaborating closely with regional sales and business teams.
This Product Manager role is a remote role, covering United Kingdom, Ireland, Belgium and The Netherlands. Location is flexible, travel is required (up to 60%). The role is a new role, supporting a new regional alignment.
Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:

• Lead the growth of our CST portfolio and spearhead the introduction of enabling technologies, ensuring market leadership and expansion. Drive business development initiatives to enhance portfolio value and maximise market impact

• Develop and implement strategies to maximise the performance of current offerings, while leading the planning and execution of comprehensive launch plans for next-generation technologies

• Oversee the sales funnel, leveraging Sales Force Dot Com to track and optimize sales opportunities, ensuring accurate forecasting, pipeline health, and sales team performance

• Deliver training programs that equip both customers and sales teams with a deep understanding of the clinical benefits and technical advancements of our technologies, enhancing product adoption

• Develop and execute reimbursement strategies to secure market access and drive sustainable growth for both existing and future technologies, with a focus on robotics

• Build a business intelligence system that provides competitive insights and objection-handling strategies to empower local sales teams and identify business development opportunities

• Establish and maintain relationships with Key Opinion Leaders and healthcare professionals, ensuring our strategies align with market needs and drive deeper engagement

Required Knowledge and Experience:

• Experience in Spinal, Orthopaedics, or Neuromodulation therapies within sales or marketing roles

• Experience in capital sales or marketing

• Proven ability to operate in a complex business environment and work effectively with sales & regional marketing management

Finance Applications Administrator

title: Junior Marketing Specialist
description:
Jitterbit is looking for a high-energy, detail-oriented Junior Marketing Specialist to join our performance marketing team.
We are looking for a true go-getter and self-starter - someone who is naturally curious, loves figuring out how platforms work, and takes absolute pride in flawless execution. If you are eager to get hands-on experience managing campaigns, diving into data, and owning critical marketing systems, this is your launchpad.
In this role, you will help run our marketing engine. You'll spend half of your time on the technical, operational side - building automation workflows, scheduling emails, and tracking data in HubSpot and Salesforce . The other half will be spent in the exciting world of paid acquisition - creating ads, partnering with design to build creatives, and working with our agency to launch and optimize PPC and Paid Social campaigns.
Key Responsibilities
Marketing Operations

•
HubSpot Automation: Set up, test, and maintain HubSpot workflows to support lead nurturing and campaign tracking.

•
Email Logistics: Build and schedule marketing emails in HubSpot (we provide the templates and the copy; you handle the technical setup and QA).

•
AI Project Coordination: Support inbound and outbound AI functions across various AI tools and platforms (e.g., Gong, Artisan, Qualified, etc.).

•
Tracking Setup: Ensure tracking pixels, UTMs, and campaigns are correctly set up so data flows smoothly into Salesforce.

•
Basic Reporting: Help pull campaign data and maintain reports in HubSpot and Salesforce to show what campaigns are working.

Paid Media & Ad Management

•
Ad Copywriting & Asset Coordination: Write short, punchy ad copy for paid social/search and work directly with our Design team to get the images/videos needed.

•
Agency Collaboration: Act as a key coordinator with our external ad agency to help get campaigns live on time.

•
Ad Optimization: Monitor Google Ads and LinkedIn Campaign Manager daily to identify quick-win optimizations (e.g., pausing underperforming ads, adjusting budgets).

Campaign Project Management & Reporting

•
End-to-End Campaign Management: Manage marketing campaign timelines, workflows, and launch schedules from kickoff to execution to ensure on-time delivery.

•
Cross-Functional Coordination: Collaborate directly with Content, Design, Sales, and external partners to gather assets, align messaging, and ensure successful campaign launches.

•
Dashboards & Performance Insights: Build and maintain clear reporting dashboards to monitor campaign performance, track KPIs, and provide actionable insights to stakeholders.

•
Experience: 2-3 years of experience in digital marketing, operations, or paid ads (agency background is a huge plus!).

•
The "Go-Getter" Attitude: You are a self-starter. When you don't know how to do something, your first instinct is to research, watch a tutorial, and try to solve it before asking.

•
Tool Exposure: Familiarity with HubSpot (or a similar automation tool) and Salesforce is highly desired, but a proven ability to learn complex software quickly is a must.

•
Detail-Oriented: You triple-check your links, your spelling, and your workflow logic before hitting "Publish."

•
Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills. You can collaborate smoothly with design, our agency partners, and internal stakeholders.

Why You'll Love This Role
You won't be stuck doing just one thing. You’ll have full visibility into how operational efficiency directly impacts paid revenue, making you a highly visible and critical contributor to Jitterbit 's growth.

title: Employee Experience Technical Program Lead, Senior Advisor
description:
Employee Experience Technical Program Lead, Sr. Advisor
The Employee Listening Program Lead, Sr. Advisor serves as a key member of the Employee Listening & People Science team, helping ensure listening programs are coordinated, accessible, and delivered with consistency and excellence.
This role acts as the connective thread across enterprise listening efforts-partnering with stakeholders to coordinate listening activities, guide survey planning, support successful execution, and maintain a positive participant experience.
The role serves as the steward of listening program processes, survey enablement, and stakeholder support, helping ensure listening activities are aligned across the organization while balancing business needs and employee experience considerations.
This position also helps enable survey owners across HR by providing guidance, resources, and support that allow listening initiatives to be delivered effectively and consistently.
Key Responsibilities:
Employee Listening Governance & Intake Coordination

• Own the enterprise listening intake and consultation process for employee surveys and listening activities.

• Partner with stakeholders to understand proposed listening efforts and help align timing, audience, and business objectives.

• Maintain visibility into listening activities occurring across HR and other functions to support a coordinated employee listening experience.

• Facilitate review processes that promote alignment, reduce duplication, and help manage employee survey fatigue.

• Support listening governance practices by helping stakeholders navigate listening standards, processes, and decision-making frameworks.

• Maintain and communicate the enterprise listening calendar and key milestones across listening initiatives.

Survey Program Ownership & Execution Excellence

• Serve as the program owner for enterprise employee listening surveys and listening initiatives.

Flying Bisons is a leading Strategic Design & Digital Consulting company based in Warsaw, with projects across Europe and the Middle East. Our mission is to help our clients Unleash Digital Potential™ .

Our uniqueness comes from going beyond design craft. As we wrote in our manifestos - Strategic Design - Manifest and Strategic Design - The Future of Design - design craft is only 10% of success . That’s why we’re building the discipline of Strategic Design - and we want you to be part of it.
Role context
We are looking for an ambitious Junior or early Mid-level Designer who wants to grow in an AI-native environment.
You do not need to be an AI expert.
You do not need to know how to code.
And you do not need several years of commercial experience.
What matters much more to us is whether you are curious, willing to experiment, quick to learn and already trying to use AI as part of your design process.
Maybe you have already tested Lovable, v0, Bolt, Figma Make, Cursor, Claude or another similar tool.
Maybe you have built a small app, prototype, landing page or personal project.
Or maybe you are simply the kind of person who sees a new tool and immediately wants to find out what can be done with it.

•
share interesting tools, experiments and learnings with the team.

• understands basic UX principles and can think about the entire user flow rather than individual screens,

• has a good visual sense and understands the basics of hierarchy, spacing and interface design,

• actively looks for ways to use AI to improve or speed up their design process

• is interested in how AI is changing design and wants to actively develop in this area,

• is comfortable trying new things even when they do not initially know exactly how to approach them,

• learns new tools quickly,

• is open to feedback and comfortable showing

A Day of Unreasonable Conversation (UC) is an invitation-only annual summit which serves as a
trusted, curated space designed to foster honest, nuanced, and critical discourse on the most urgent
issues of our time. The gathering bridges the gap between the entertainment industry and social
impact sectors. It connects "culture shapers"-influential television writers, showrunners, producers,
executives, and digital storytellers who are literally writing the script for the world-with frontline
changemakers, advocates, philanthropists, and issue experts.
The core mission of UC is to "unlock progress through the power of stories". In a deeply polarized
moment where trust in traditional media is at a record low, the event aims to spark writers' rooms with
new ideas and give creators the tools to drive meaningful change. UC challenges storytellers to
complicate the narrative by moving beyond flat tropes and oversimplified binaries to explore the
systemic complexities of our time. Ultimately, the goal is to bring greater nuance, empathy, and truth to
the stories that shape public perception.
UC is grounded in the belief that culture is the multiplier for change at scale. Because culture sits
upstream of policy and politics, it is where people already are. Even in times of deep fracture when
people stop listening to experts or political parties, they still listen to stories. By bringing storytellers and
problem-solvers together, UC seeks to turn stage-side insights into long-term creative collaborations
that shift culture on screen and beyond.
A Day of Unreasonable Conversation is founded and produced by the social impact agency Propper
Daley x Bully Pulpit International (BPI). The event relies on cross-sector collaboration and is fully funded
by philanthropy.

As a company married to the world of online work, Airtm will go beyond payments to build the necessary infrastructure the online-work economy needs to thrive. We are fostering an entirely new economy, giving individuals, communities, and countries the tools to take control of their financial destinies.

The team's models and tooling increasingly depend on machine learning and generative AI, and this is the role that owns what "trustworthy" means for both. TCP is committed to cultivating a diverse and inclusive team.
About TCP (TimeClock Plus)
For more than 30 years, TCP has helped organizations engage their people by providing flexible, mobile timekeeping and workforce management solutions. Trusted by tens of thousands of customers and millions of users, TCP delivers best-in-class technology and personalized support to organizations of all sizes in the public and private sector to meet their complex timekeeping, employee scheduling, leave management and other workforce needs. Growth is happening and our vision for a successful future is clear - We’d love for you to join us on this journey! For more information on TCP, visit or follow us on LinkedIn or Facebook.
About the Role
TCP is investing in the systems that run its revenue organization and is hiring a Salesforce and Systems Manager. This role is focused on making Salesforce work better for TCP's go-to-market teams, shaping how sales, partnership, and customer success experience the platform day to day, from configuration and page layouts through reporting. This is a hands-on individual contributor role: you will be the dedicated Salesforce administrator for Revenue Operations, collaborating with the Salesforce admins who support other departments on the shared roadmap, release cadence, and integrations. It also owns TCP's growing portfolio of internal applications and agents built with Claude Code, currently a half dozen apps serving sales, partnerships, and revenue operations, including apps running in BaseCamp GTM along with the skills, connectors, access rules, and documentation those systems depend on. Sitting inside Revenue Operations keeps the work close to the sales, partnership, and customer success teams that rely on these tools every day. This role is remote, US-based, and reports to the SVP of Enterprise Sales, Partnership, and Revenue Operations.
As a Salesforce and Systems Manager, you will:

• Improve the Salesforce experience for GTM teams. Configure objects, flows, validation rules, permission sets, and page layouts to match how sales, partnership, and customer success actually work, and remove the friction that slows them down.

• Collaborate on the platform roadmap and releases. Partner with the Salesforce admins in other departments on the shared roadmap, release cadence, and technical debt backlog, and test seasonal releases, managed package upgrades, and sandbox refreshes so changes land without disrupting GTM teams.

• Keep integrations healthy. Help maintain the connections between Salesforce and the ERP, marketing automation, and billing platforms so data stays accurate across systems.

• Manage internal systems. Own every internal application and agent built with Claude Code from first deployment through retirement, including the skills, prompts, and connectors they depend on.

• Govern AI access and cost. Set access rules so each agent reaches only the data its purpose requires, audit those rules on a schedule, and monitor usage, cost, and output quality.

• Build reporting leaders trust. Deliver reports and dashboards that give sales, partnership, customer success, and finance one shared view of the pipeline.

• Enable the teams who use these tools. Train users, publish self-service documentation, and keep runbooks current so no system depends on one person’s memory.

• 3+ years administering Salesforce in a business-critical production environment.

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Intuition Machines uses AI/ML to build enterprise security products. We apply our research to systems that serve hundreds of millions of people, with a team distributed around the world. You are probably familiar with our best-known product, the hCaptcha security suite. Our approach is simple: low overhead, small teams, and rapid iteration.
As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer, you will focus on engineering solutions related to performance, availability, security, and cost-effectiveness. We consider these non-functional features to be core requirements for us and our customers. You will work at multiple layers of our internet-scale system (infrastructure, data, application logic) and build the solutions.
Using AI: Coding agents are indisputably useful tools. We provide access to the top 3 models, and were early adopters of evals-first development flows. Familiarity with coding using agents is part of all interviews. However, reliability and correctness are critical for us. You will need to read and understand every line of code with your name on it, and it will be reviewed by both people and machines.
What you will do:

• Work with large-scale systems (handling millions of requests per second, serving millions of users, across multiple cloud providers).

• Develop solutions to enhance performance, availability, security, and cost-effectiveness.

• Keep us up, keep us fast, and keep our dev teams productive ensuring that every peer release improves performance across the spectrum including quality, security, uptime, speed-to-deliver, threat detection, and customer engagement.

• Source improvement ideas, priority and capabilities from customers, the internal community, new and existing system metrics. Make decisions rapidly.

• Be creative and desire an environment where you can directly create value and be a force to improve the experience for our customers.

What we are looking for:

• Expert in Kubernetes.

• Expert in monitoring applications, infrastructure and network.

• Background in software engineering with expertise in backend development within Kubernetes-based systems.

• Strong programming skills in one or more of the following languages: Python, JavaScript, Go, C++, Rust.

• Strong understanding and experience in networking, proxies, content delivery networks (Cloudflare)

• Multi cloud experience including virtual networking, load balancing, web application firewall.

• Strong experience with CI/CD.

• Hands-on experience in development and orchestration within high-scale, high-uptime, and high-reliability environments.

• Minimum of six years of hands-on experience in related roles (engineering, DevOps, SRE).

• Familiarity with distributed systems, including queue-first architectures and sharding.

• Demonstrated engineering expertise, including gathering requirements, problem-solving, and making recommendations.

• Preferred: Familiarity with security frameworks, attack vectors, botnets, and impact analysis.

What we offer:

• Fully remote position with flexible working hours.

• An inspiring team of colleagues spread all over the world.

• Pleasant, modern development and deployment workflows: ship early, ship often.

• High impact: lots of users, happy customers, high growth, and cutting edge R&D.

• Flat organization, direct interaction with customer teams.

We celebrate equality of opportunity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. Join us as we transform cybersecurity, user privacy, and machine learning online!
Please note that all positions require pre-employment screening, including third-party verification of work history, education, and identity, as well as a final in-person interview and identity verification step, which will be conducted in your country of residence.

FCM takes a holistic approach to corporate travel, specializing in managing national and global travel programs for medium and large businesses.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
KAYAK, part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), is a leading travel search engine. With billions of queries across our platforms, we help people find their perfect flight, stay, rental car and vacation package. We're also transforming business travel with a new corporate travel solution, KAYAK for Business.

 

As an employee of KAYAK, you will be part of a travel company that operates a portfolio of global metasearch brands including Momondo, Cheapflights and HotelsCombined, among others. From start-up to industry leader, innovation is in our DNA and every employee has an opportunity to make their mark. Our focus is on building the best travel search engine to make it easier for everyone to experience the world.

 

KAYAK is looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented Executive Assistant (EA)/Communications Specialist to support the executive team with administrative and coordination tasks. This role sits at the center of how our executive team runs day to day: owning complex calendars, coordinating communications, and keeping the leadership team's priorities moving. The ideal candidate is a problem-solver who thrives in a fast-paced environment, exercises sound judgment with sensitive information, and can juggle competing priorities without dropping details.

 

Note, this position is required to work from our Norwalk, CT office 3 days per week.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own and manage complex, high-volume calendars for members of the executive team, including scheduling meetings across multiple time zones, resolving calendar conflicts.

- Coordinate logistics for executive/leadership meetings, offsites, and leadership gatherings, including agendas, materials, room booking, and travel.

- Prepare and format presentations, briefing documents, and meeting notes.

- Serve as a liaison between the executive team and internal/external stakeholders, managing correspondence and follow-ups.

- Track action items and next steps from leadership meetings and ensure timely follow-through.

- Handle confidential information with discretion and professionalism.

- Manage administrative tasks (e.g billing and travel details).

- Anticipate the needs of the executive team and proactively address them.

WHAT YOU BRING

- 3+ years of experience in an administrative, executive support, or communications coordination role, ideally supporting senior leadership.

- Exceptional organizational and time-management skills with a proven ability to manage complex calendars.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with sharp attention to detail.

- Proficiency with calendar and productivity tools

- Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion.

- A proactive, resourceful, AI-forward mindset and the ability to work independently.

- Comfort operating in a fast-paced and rapidly changing environment.

 

We know that no candidate will check every box. If you meet most of these criteria and are excited about this work, we encourage you to apply.

 

BENEFITS AND PERKS

- Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per location, per year

- Company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)

- No meeting Fridays

- Paid parental leave

- Generous paid vacation + time off for your birthday

- Paid volunteer time

- Focus on your career growth:

- Development Dollars

- Leadership development

- Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings

- Travel Discounts

- Employee Resource Groups

- Competitive retirement and health plans

- Free lunch 2 days per week

- Focus on mental health and well-being:

- Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth

- Company-paid subscription to HeadSpace

 

COMPENSATION

There are a variety of factors that go into determining a salary range, including but not limited to external market benchmark data, geographic location, and years of experience sought/required. The range for this Massachusetts -based role is $95,000-$120,000.

If you're the kind of person who's quietly outgrown your current role, who wants to be surrounded by people as driven as you are, this is the one to look at.

What you'll own

You'll maximise the lifetime value of an assigned portfolio of key accounts. Two focuses, equally weighted: secure renewals & protect ARR, and drive growth by finding and closing the cross-sell and upsell opportunities hiding inside your book.

• Stay honest and transparent, even when the news is hard to deliver.

• Stay calm under pressure and steady the team through any setbacks.

As a JerseySTEM volunteer, you have the opportunity to contribute your unique skills and interests to support our cause. Together, we can create a brighter future for the next generation of female leaders in STEM.

title: Motion Designer
description:
About WPP Production

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company - powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit  WPP.com .

Great motion design doesn't just move; it tells a story. We're looking for someone who gets that.

We're hiring a Motion Designer to join our team in Dhaka, working primarily on video content for global brands, delivered at scale across markets and languages. Every version we build needs to feel as considered as the original, so the role is as much about judgment and craft as it is about output.

You'll turn storyboards and brand assets into finished animation, with a sharp eye for timing, easing, and pacing, and solid editing and color grading skills. Understanding how storyboards, pacing, framing, and visual flow work will serve you well here. It's often what separates technically competent animation from animation that genuinely connects.

If precision, pacing, and getting the small details right matter to you, this role is built around exactly that.

The position will be offered at either the Motion Designer or Senior Motion Designer level, depending on your experience, portfolio, and creative capabilities.

 

The Work

• Turn creative briefs, storyboards, design layouts, and brand assets into polished motion graphics and animation.

• Craft 2D animation, kinetic typography, transitions, and visual effects with close attention to timing, easing, and pacing.

• Animate interfaces and digital products through UI animation, micro-interactions, and product walkthroughs.

• Edit video footage, integrating graphics, typography, music, and sound into cohesive final content.

• Apply color correction and grading to maintain the right tone, mood, and visual consistency.

• Adapt master creative across languages, markets, sizes, and formats without losing what made the original work.

• Prepare final content for different platforms and aspect ratios, including 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, social media, digital advertising, and broadcast.

• Build and maintain reusable After Effects project templates, motion graphics templates (.mogrt), and organized asset libraries.

• Collaborate with designers, project managers, and stakeholders on creative direction, brand guidelines, and delivery requirements.

• Apply internal and client feedback thoughtfully and accurately through each round of refinement.

• Check every version against the approved creative and copy for visual, content, and technical accuracy before delivery.

• Manage render queues, resolve technical issues, and keep project files clean and organized.

 

What You'll Need

• 5 years of experience as a Motion Designer or AFX Editor in an agency, production studio, or in-house creative team. Candidates with less experience are welcome to apply if they can demonstrate strong fundamentals and sound creative judgment.

• Portfolio featuring finished work that shows your skills, contribution, and range.

• Strong, hands-on skills in Adobe After Effects, including keyframing, masking, rotoscoping, tracking, and compositing.

• Working knowledge of Premiere Pro, Figma, Photoshop, and Illustrat

Dans le cadre du projet “Horizon Europe EMPOWR” nous recrutons un post-doctorat en réalité augmentée. Sous la responsabilité de Guillaume MOREAU et en collaboration avec les membres de l’équipe INUIT, les principales tâches du poste sont :

• Participe à la rédaction des livrables

• Participe aux assemblées générales du projet ainsi qu’aux réunions techniques

• Rédige des publications scientifiques

Le Projet
L’objectif principal du projet EMPOWR est d’introduire un écosystème d’augmentation multicouches qui transformera les espaces de travail industriels en environnements adaptatifs et intelligents, où les travailleurs ne seront plus simplement des opérateurs, mais des décideurs améliorés. Cet écosystème favorisera la collaboration homme-machine grâce à deux technologies clés : un outil de réalité augmenté adaptatif , accompagné d’un compagnon IA cognitif , Adaptive Learning Manufacturing Assistant (ALMA ) , un système d’IA basé sur des modèles de langage (LLM) qui jouera le rôle d’intelligence de l’espace de travail industriel.

L’équipe
L’équipe INUIT (Interaction Naturelle Immersive pour l’Utilisateur) du département Informatique mène des recherches sur l’interaction en réalité mixte en concevant des systèmes de réalité virtuelle et augmentée, en proposant des modèles et des métaphores évalués par des expériences utilisateurs. Les domaines d’application incluent notamment l’Industrie du Futur, la Santé, la Défense et le Patrimoine Culturel.
L’équipe INUIT est responsable de la conception et du développement de l’outil de réalité augmentée adaptatif. Ce dernier intégrera un espace de conception en réalité augmentée conçu pour prendre en charge plusieurs formes d’affichage d’informations via des augmentations. L’affichage s’appuiera en pratique sur des éléments fournis par ALMA ainsi que sur des signaux physiologiques surveillés chez les travailleurs. L’outil de RA sera déployé dans deux cas d’usage industriels, et des études utilisateurs seront menées pour validation.

Compétences, connaissances et expériences indispensables :

• Réalités augmentée et virtuelle (requis)

title: Staff Electrical Engineer, Hardware Test
description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 

Job Description:
Shield AI is seeking a Staff Electrical Engineer to define and lead the electrical test-equipment strategy that enables X-BAT hardware to move from rapid development through qualification, integration, and sustained operation. The Hardware Test Engineering team builds the multidisciplinary systems used to characterize, stress, verify, and troubleshoot mission-critical aircraft components and subsystems.
You will be the technical authority for a portfolio of electrical test capabilities rather than a single stand or project. You will establish common architectures, engineering standards, safety practices, and lifecycle expectations; align capability roadmaps with program risk and verification needs; and lead the most ambiguous or consequential test-equipment efforts from concept through deployment. Your influence will extend into aircraft design through design-for-testability, interface definition, reliability learning, and closed-loop corrective action.
This is a hands-on staff individual-contributor role with broad organizational reach. You will remain close to schematics, code, hardware, and lab operations while multiplying the effectiveness of other engineers through architecture, reviews, mentorship, reusable platforms, and clear technical decisions. Direct people management is not required.
What success looks like
Create a coherent test-equipment architecture and roadmap that closes the program's highest-risk verification gaps and supports development, qualification, and recurring test needs.
Standardize reusable electrical, software, data, safety, calibration, and documentation patterns that shorten delivery time without weakening rigor.
Increase equipment reliability, diagnosability, maintainability, and utilization while reducing recurring failures, manual interventions, and one-off designs.
Raise the quality of aircraft requirements and interfaces by making testability, observability, fault isolation, and verification strategy explicit early in design.
Develop senior technical talent and create durable practices that allow the organization to deliver more capability through the team rather than through individual heroics.

title: Automation Engineer, Wet Lab
description: Role summary: At Differential Bio, our mission is to unlock the potential of the bioeconomy by fixing how biological R&D and scale-up are done . Today, bioprocess development is slow, expensive, and limited by the economics of lab hardware. A typical system runs 4, 8, or 24 bioreactors in parallel, and a single run can cost anywhere from hundreds to several thousand dollars. Our ambition is different: 100 parallel bioreactor runs at around $10 per run. Why does that matter? Because radically reducing the cost per insight changes what is possible. Instead of running a handful of carefully selected experiments, we can generate dense, standardized datasets across thousands of conditions. That data is at the core of Differential Bio. First, we automate high-throughput data generation. Then we use our proprietary datasets to train AI models that understand how bioprocesses behave across conditions and scales - with the long-term goal of building a digital twin of fermentation at any scale . We have already built two end-to-end automated fermentation pods that operate continuously and generate experimental data every week. Being vertically integrated all the way down to the physical lab has proven to be a major advantage for us. Now we are hiring the first role dedicated entirely to lab automation . You will take over this domain from our founder and CTO, Martin, report directly to him, and own how our automation platform develops from here. This is, in many ways, the role we always wished existed : high autonomy, genuinely difficult engineering problems, the freedom and resources to solve them properly, and a mission worth the hard work

As Founder's Associate, you’ll work directly with the founders across the full customer loop. You’ll talk to customers in German, help them get into the product, support them when they’re stuck, and help them decide whether to buy-honestly, not with a hard sell. Beyond that, you’ll take on business development, product feedback, and ops work that keeps Norman moving. This is a broad early-stage role across customer success, support, BD, product, and ops.
Full-time, remote within Germany.
Tasks

• Take inbound calls and chats with people who found Norman and want to know if it fits their business.

• Run demos and guided walkthroughs in German, tailored to their workflow. Help people onboard: setup, first tasks, and day-to-day product questions.

• Identify product gaps and opportunities for improvement from these conversations. Help get them to production.

• Own the purchase conversation: clarify fit, handle objections, and help suitable customers decide and get started. No sales quota or commission today-judgment and follow-through matter more than pressure.

• Support current users when they’re stuck or considering next steps (customer support + success).

• Help with business development: partnerships, outbound experiments, and turning strong conversations into pipeline where it makes sense.

• Use Norman every day, catch friction early, and feed clear examples back into product.

• Work with founders on product priorities: document recurring questions, objections, and workflow gaps; help turn them into better onboarding, help content, and product decisions.

• Take on ops work that keeps a small company running smoothly (process, tools, follow-ups, light project ownership).

• Help with webinars, short product videos, or a small community as we grow education around Norman .

Requirements

• Native-level German (spoken and written) for confident, natural customer conversations.

• Willingness to wear many hats in an early-stage startup-CS, support, BD, product feedback, and ops in the same week.

• Strong listening: ask useful questions, explain software patiently, and avoid jargon.

• You learn products and processes fast and care why people (and systems) get stuck.

• You stay organized and follow through across calls, tickets, BD threads, and internal ops.

• Based in Germany.

Nice to have:

• SaaS/fintech experience or experience with tools for Freiberufler and small businesses.

• Familiarity with invoicing, bookkeeping, or German tax workflows (no Steuerberater required).

• CRM experience; you’ve done demos, support, partnerships, or light ops/project work before.

• Interest in teaching in public (webinars, short videos, community).

Benefits

• Work remotely within Germany.

• Direct work with founders in a small team-high ownership, real impact.

• Broad mandate across customers, product, and the company-not a siloed role.

• Your feedback and work show up quickly in how Norman grows.

Interested? Send your CV or LinkedIn plus a short note covering your customer-facing (or early-startup) experience, why this role, and one example of helping someone get unstuck-a customer, a process, or a product.

description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Stripe’s Financial Crimes Compliance Risk Oversight (FinCRO) team is looking for a U.S. Regulatory Compliance Lead for our Banking-as-a-Service (BaaS) business. You’ll own second-line oversight of Stripe’s U.S. BaaS products and bank-fintech partnerships. The work is practical and cross-functional: turn federal and state requirements and supervisory expectations into clear policies, controls, monitoring, evidence, and ownership.

What you’ll do

This role is focused on U.S. BaaS regulation. You’ll work across sponsor-bank and fintech responsibility mapping; BSA/AML and sanctions; consumer protection and fair lending; deposits and FDIC insurance representations; privacy, cybersecurity, incident response, and third-party risk; complaints and disputes; payment network and ACH rules; state money transmission and lending requirements; and regulatory exams, remediation, and change management.

Responsibilities

• Own the second-line compliance framework for Stripe’s U.S. BaaS products (i.e., Capital, Issuing, and Treasury) and bank-fintech partnerships. Make sure responsibilities are clear across Stripe, sponsor banks, program managers, processors, and other partners.

• Turn U.S. federal and state laws, guidance, enforcement actions, and supervisory expectations into practical policies, product requirements, controls, procedures, evidence standards, and monitoring.

• Set and oversee controls for BSA/AML, customer identification and verification, customer due diligence and beneficial ownership, transaction monitoring, suspicious activity escalation, sanctions screening, and recordkeeping.

• Oversee consumer and lending compliance for BaaS products, including UDAAP; Regulations E, Z, B, and DD; fair lending; FCRA; SCRA; FDCPA; complaints and disputes; adverse action; collections; marketing and disclosures; fees; account restrictions; and account closures.

• Oversee deposit-product compliance, including FDIC insurance representations, Reg CC, pass-through insurance requirements, pooled or custodial structures, customer-level records, ledger integrity, reconciliation, and access to funds.

• Define compliance expectations for privacy, cybersecurity, incident escalation, operational resilience, business continuity, data access, record retention, and an orderly wind-down of BaaS programs.

• Provide second-line oversight on behalf of sponsor banks and other BaaS partners through risk assessments, due diligence, contract requirements, control testing, performance and complaint monitoring, issue management, and exit planning.

• Review new U.S. BaaS products and material changes. Identify applicable obligations, control gaps, licensing implications, and launch conditions, then drive remediation to closure with clear owners.

• Keep pace with U.S. BaaS regulatory developments and enforcement trends, assess what they mean for Stripe, and coordinate timely changes with first-line teams.

• Help Stripe prepare for and respond to U.S. regulatory exams, supervisory engagements, audits, and formal commitments. Maintain defensible obligation mappings and evidence, identify gaps, and oversee remediation.

• Work closely with Product, Legal, Risk, Engineering, Operations, Internal Audit, sponsor-bank teams, and other specialists. Clarify ownership, challenge control design and execution, and give leaders a clear view of risk and progress.

Wyndham Hotels & Resorts is now seeking a Account Director, Business Development to join our team at the Remote in the United States location in Remote, Remote.

Why Wyndham?

By joining Wyndham Hotels & Resorts, you will play an integral role in our mission to make hotel travel possible for all. You’ll be part of one of the largest hotel franchise companies in the world, where we strive to deliver the best value to our owners and guests. Most importantly, you’ll be entrusted to live our unique Count on Me culture, set by our core values of integrity, accountability, inclusive, caring and fun. At Wyndham, we provide all team members the opportunity to grow through best-in-class training and career development, leadership training, mentorship opportunities and educational support. Supporting our team members is a top priority, which is why we offer competitive compensation and benefits, vacation, team member appreciation days, workplace flexibility and much more. At Wyndham Hotels & Resorts, we value and embrace a culture of diversity, equity and inclusion that supports team members of all backgrounds and experiences. We can’t wait to welcome you!

The Role

The position of Account Director, Business Development is responsible for driving incremental revenue growth within the NAMER region from assigned segments by using general business acumen to prospect and expand our business reach.
The primary focus will be on identifying and developing new business opportunities across multiple industries and business segments, including corporate, infrastructure, and other high-growth sectors that align with WH&R brand offerings. The position will be responsible for proactively identifying and engaging with potential clients, nurturing relationships, and driving new business growth through research, identification, qualification, conversion, account activation and ultimate graduation to another seller/team based on industry segmentation and customer profile. All new accounts retained by Account Director, Business Development should be highly engaged with a strong long-term potential for growth.

Overall, this position will require a strong skill set and affinity for business development. Leads for new business may be provided or may need to be self-cultivated through research tools, industry reports, etc. Desired qualities include exceptional communication skills, persistence, adaptability, tenacity, creativity, superb organization skills and proficiency with systems and processes.

The team member should possess a good knowledge of WH&R brands, as well as overall company strategy and associated management process and practice. The team member may represent at customer facing events and internal meetings where potential revenue opportunities are presented. Strong communication and collaboration skills are required to navigate effectively throughout the organization.

What you'll do

Account Acquisition

Must be able to utilize tools such as LinkedIn, Dodge Data & Analytics, Google Alerts, ZoomInfo and other tools, as assigned, to research companies to identify customer potential and develop communication tactics to reach out, secure response, and qualify the customer. This will require extensive in-person, email, and telephone solicitation to gain engagement to qualify potential new accounts.

Position will also leverage internal reporting to help identify and find new business opportunities while ensuring WH&R optimizes participation in trades shows and customer facing events where new revenue opportunities are available.

Account Management

Once a new account is converted, use appropriate tools and tactics to solidify engagement and expand contact network with an organization to optimize revenue generation to WH&R properties. title: Regional Operations Manager, ICQA
description:
Stord is The Consumer Experience Company, powering seamless checkout through delivery for today's leading brands. Stord is rapidly growing and is on track to double our revenue in the next 18 months. To meet and exceed this target, Stord is strategically scaling teams across the entire company, and seeking energetic experts to help us achieve our mission.
By combining comprehensive commerce-enablement technology with high-volume fulfillment services, Stord provides brands a platform to compete with retail giants. Stord manages over $10 billion of commerce annually through its fulfillment, warehousing, transportation, and operator-built software suite including OMS, Pre- and Post-Purchase, and WMS platforms. Stord is leveling the playing field for all brands to deliver the best consumer experience at scale.
With Stord , brands can increase cart conversion, improve unit economics, and drive sustained customer loyalty. Stord ’s end-to-end commerce solutions combine best-in-class omnichannel fulfillment and shipping with leading technology to ensure fast shipping, reliable delivery promises, easy access to more channels, and improved margins on every order.
Hundreds of leading DTC and B2B companies like AG1, True Classic, Native, Seed Health, quip, goodr, Sundays for Dogs, and more trust Stord to deliver industry-leading consumer experiences on every order. Stord is headquartered in Atlanta with facilities across the United States, Canada, and Europe. Stord is backed by top-tier investors including Kleiner Perkins, Franklin Templeton, Founders Fund, Strike Capital, Baillie Gifford, and Salesforce Ventures.

Job Title:
Regional Operations Manager - ICQA

Reports To:
Director of Inventory Control & Quality Assurance (ICQA)

Location:
Remote with regular travel to assigned regional fulfillment centers (East or West Region)

Position Summary:

The Regional Operations Manager - ICQA will lead regional execution of Stord ’s network-wide ICQA and Quality programs. This role ensures compliance with company inventory control standards, drives data accuracy, and partners with site leadership to identify and eliminate root causes of inventory and process errors. The position serves as the operational extension of the Director of ICQA, accountable for inventory health, shrink performance, and audit adherence across multiple facilities in their assigned region.

Key Responsibilities:
Program Execution & Oversight

• Oversee all ICQA activities (cycle counts, physical inventories, audits, investigations, reconciliations, projects) for the assigned region.

• Ensure consistent application of SOPs, KPI tracking, and corrective action processes.

• Lead deployment of ICQA tools, training matrices, and network-standard reporting.

• Partner with Fulfillment Operations to maintain control limits for exceptions, adjustments, and location accuracy.

Performance & Metrics

• Own regional metrics, including Inventory Accuracy, Shrink %, L%R, Audit Completion, and Exception Closure Rates.

• Review daily/weekly data to identify trends, high-risk areas, and performance drift.

• Conduct weekly reviews with site ICQA and Site Leads to drive continuous improvement and accountability.

Compliance & Governance

• Ensure compliance with GMP, GDP, and customer-specific quality requirements.

• Support execution of CAPA, audit responses, and inventory-related escalations.

• Maintain proper segregation of duties between ICQA and Operations to preserve inventory integrity.

People Leadership

• Directly manage and develop site-level ICQA Managers or Supervisors across the region.
